title: iPhone held by fix-hero-exit-threaded, unused for 5 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
fix-hero-exit-threaded has held the iPhone lease for 5 min without a phone run (iphone.mjs run, scroll, record or gesture; since 18:28Z, lease taken by fix-hero-exit-threaded). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: phone-queue (owner iphone-runner; its note names the phone).
fix-hero-exit-threaded: run your phone part now, or release the lease (node tools/lock.mjs release iphone --owner fix-hero-exit-threaded) so the next one can start, or say here why it waits.
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the phone is used again or released (tools/idle.mjs, I-105, I-111).

Known: the phone holder's wait command kept running after it got the phone (incident I-165, answered in thread T-149).

- fix-hero-exit-threaded starts its end-menu flicks when that wait ends, about 18:38Z.
- After it: the last fast-flick session, once v8's last check is done.

What you need to do: nothing.
Fixed yet, lead ? do some workaround.

The phone is mine now; my robot-finger swipes start as soon as the Mac's current test job ends (by 18:45Z at the latest).

- Robot test: fast short swipes at the end of the page, rev 6 vs rev 7 (about 8 min).
- Then a short step for you in Your steps: swipe the menu open and closed on two pages.
- I release the phone right after.

What you need to do: nothing yet.

Workaround done: I told fix-hero-exit-threaded to start its robot swipes now instead of waiting for the Mac test job.

- Why it still waited: it queued for a quiet Mac, behind a 9-min tool test that ends by 18:44Z.
- Its swipes count open/close results only, no timing, so a busy Mac doesn't matter.
- The wrong wait command (incident I-165) is already over; a tool fix is in progress.
- From now a helper (mgmt-devices) checks the phone every minute and pushes the holder after 2 idle minutes (T-149).

What you need to do: nothing.

Correction: the early start was blocked, so the robot swipes start when the Mac test job ends, by 18:45Z.

- The safety check in Claude Code refused a phone run outside the agent's lock slot. The agent was right not to work around it.
- Stopping the test job early would waste its 9 minutes, so I let it finish (about 3 min left).

What you need to do: nothing.
